extra_quotes: To evaluate the FoMs, a simulation framework is established using DNN+NeuroSim V1.5 [5] as the primary simulation engine.
To address limitations in static IR drop modeling, we augment the framework with Badcrossbar [6].
NeuroSim is also extended to support the evaluation of crossbar tiling.
While reprogrammability and write endurance are important considerations for neuromorphic computing, they are not considered in this evaluation because the DFT coefficients remain constant.
